messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'us-west-2/gpu-ptx' at 98% queued requests. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions in 5m; all failed. Paging on-call: @maria

maria: paging in. I see the alert, pulling up dashboards now. Anyone on devex or ML that touched a model rollout in last 2 hours?

alex: was on deploy earlier, we rolled model 'mosaic-embed-v2.1' at 09:18. Known to increase sequence processing by ~1.8x for some prompts.

ben: looking at pool heatmap — queue length increasing from 200 -> 1.6k requests in 12m, latency p50->p95 spiked, tokens/sec per-GPU dropped. Autoscaler logs show repeated respawning but failing due to quota: "max-gpu-in-region reached" and some instances failing health checks.

priya: mosaic-embed-v2.1 changed prefix caching layout; warm-up uses larger KV footprints. That will increase memory and could make some hosts fail health checks when warm cycles overlap.

lena: support is getting noise from 2 customers: AcmePay and FathomAI. AcmePay seeing 500/503s, FathomAI reports "timeouts on embeddings endpoint". ETA on mitigation?

maria: immediate triage plan: 1) divert new traffic away from v2.1 to v2.0 fallback 2) temporarily lower concurrency per-GPU for that route 3) open handoff to SRE to expand capacity if possible. Ben, can you attempt a controlled fallback?

ben: starting canary rollback route rule now. Command: ```
# change routing for embeddings.service -> prefer mosaic-embed-v2.0
rdwctl route update embeddings --pref-model=mosaic-embed-v2.0 --weight-override=100
```

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: route update queued. Change will take ~30s to propagate.

maria: switching traffic to v2.0 now. Also enabling emergency rate-limiter to shed heavy clients: ```
rdwctl rl create acme-heavy --route embeddings --limit=200r/s --burst=50
```

alex: note — autoscaler failures were due to hitting soft quota for GPUs in us-west-2 (contracted dedicated pools plus ephemeral host budget). I can try spinning in cross-region fallback (us-east-1) but warm-up there will also need time.

ben: rollback to v2.0 is at 80% traffic in 1m, p99 latency improving, queue de-queuing faster. Good signal. Still seeing about 1400 queued items but decreasing. Health checks still failing on 2 nodes that hit OOM during kv warm step. Collecting node logs.

priya: extracting a failing request stack from logs: ```
ERROR kv_warm: keyset size=14M, mem_needed=18.5GB, mem_avail=12.3GB -> OOM
TRACE request_id=xyz123 prompt_len=16k tokens
``` Might be a small subset of requests that trigger long context usage.

lena: notifying AcmePay: "We're rolling traffic to a stable model version and throttling heavy clients. Expect improvements in 5-10 minutes; we'll follow up."

maria: can we temporarily set a max-context cutoff for embeddings route to avoid huge requests? We should 429 anything > 32k tokens for now.

alex: yes, adding input sanitization policy: ```
rdwctl policy add embeddings reject_large_context --max-tokens=32000 --status=429
```

deploy-bot: policy added and active.

ben: autoscaler logs show attempts to add nodes but API rate-limited by cloud quota. I've opened a support quota request but that won't be instant. Trying cross-region spillover: routing 20% to us-east-1 to relieve pressure.

priya: also flagging a change to model v2.1 quantization/prefetch that increases per-token work. We'll put an annotation in the rollout ticket. For next time, we need a staged ramp with KV warm prefetch disabled at first.

maria: agreed. For now: rollback majority of traffic, enable rate-limits, cross-region spill, and OOMed nodes isolated. Ben, can you isolate the two bad nodes to prevent them from cycling and affecting the autoscaler?

ben: isolating nodes now: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-204
kubectl drain gpu-node-204 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
``` Node 204 and 211 cordoned. Thanks — cluster stability improved.

lena: update to AcmePay: "We've isolated failing hosts and routed your traffic to a stable model version; degradation should be resolved. If you still see errors please share examples. Incident team will follow up."

maria: handoff: ben, I'm going offline in ~25m. Ben will take primary SRE lead; Priya will own ML rollback tickets and postmortem. Alex will coordinate capacity/quota with cloud ops. Lena continues customer comms. Any objections?

ben: taking it. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and coordinate with cloud to get quota increased. Current metrics: queue down to 220, p95 latency nearly back to baseline.

priya: opening postmortem stub: "mosaic-embed-v2.1 caused unexpected memory footprint during KV warm -> autoscaler hit region GPU cap -> queue growth -> customer-facing 5xxs. Immediate mitigations: rollback, rate-limit, cordon OOM nodes, cross-region spill. Action items: add staged rollout with KV-prefetch off, add per-request context guardrails, add load-forecast gating for model upgrades."

maria: nice. Tagging incident severity: Sev2, customer impact limited to a subset of embedding heavy customers. Will update status page and send summary to leadership in 1hr.

deploy-bot: route rollback complete, traffic now 100% mosaic-embed-v2.0.

ben: final check: no new OOMs in last 10m; autoscaler no longer retrying. I'll keep watch and escalate if queue rises.

lena: sending follow-up note to affected customers now.

maria: thanks team. We'll reconvene for a 40m post-incident sync and draft action items. Closing pager for me, handing to ben. :thumbsup:
